tool.name: MGnify: Library strategy check
tool.description: Guess whether data is AMPLICON or not from base consensus values (BCV)

param.name: bcv
param.label: Base consensus values
param.help: Output of the Pimento assess MCP proportions (BCV) tool

tool.help:
**Library strategy check** --------------------------
Reads the base consensus values (BCV) produced by the Pimento *assess MCP proportions* tool and guesses whether the library is amplicon data:
- mean BCV >= 0.30 → the output file contains ``AMPLICON`` - otherwise → the output file is empty
In the MGnify amplicon pipeline the result gates whether the run is processed as an amplicon dataset.
